test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 05
subject: general
question: A sum of Rs. 10,000 is deposited for 1 year at the rate of interest 10% per annum, compounded half yearly. What will be the interest at the end of one year?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 10,000

Rate = 10%

Time = half yearly

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal,

R = Rate of interest and T = Time

Interest = Amount – Principal

If interest compounded half yearly

R → R/2, n → 2n
